name: Splice
description: Butt-jointed bars held by a fishplate at every joint, the splice landing on the same centre each time.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 40%; width: 100%; height: 20%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 30%; top: 22%; width: 40%; height: 56%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
